summary_en: Kissei Pharmaceutical executed a block buyback of 1.1 million shares at 3,755 yen per share on November 5, 2026, totaling approximately 4.13 billion yen and representing 2.6% of outstanding shares, using ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading.
title_en: Notice of Share Buyback via Off-Market Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 4, 2026, Kissei Pharmaceutical's board of directors authorized the execution of a block share repurchase that had been approved in principle on May 11, 2026. The company executed the buyback on November 5, 2026, purchasing 1.1 million shares at 3,755 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading, totaling approximately 4.13 billion yen. This execution represents 2.6% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock as of the reference date of 41,738,339 shares).

This execution is part of the May 11 authorization under which the company approved acquiring up to 1.3 million shares for up to 6 billion yen during the period from May 12 through December 31, 2026. As of November 4, 2026, the company had cumulatively purchased 200,000 shares for 799.31 million yen under this authorization, leaving capacity for further acquisitions.
